sources.citation: Ferrag, M. A., Friha, O., Hamouda, D., Maglaras, L., and Janicke, H. (2022). Edge-IIoTset: A New Comprehensive Realistic Cyber Security Dataset of IoT and IIoT Applications for Centralized and Federated Learning. IEEE Access, 10, 40281-40306. Tables V and VII.

feature_groups.name: arp.opcode
feature_groups.definition: ARP operation code identifying the message operation, such as request or reply.
feature_groups.admissible_range: Nonnegative integer within the ARP operation-code field; exact observed values are not supplied.

feature_groups.name: arp.hw.size
feature_groups.definition: ARP hardware-address length field.
feature_groups.admissible_range: Nonnegative integer within the ARP hardware-size field; exact observed values are not supplied.

feature_groups.name: icmp.checksum
feature_groups.definition: ICMP checksum field used for integrity checking of the ICMP message.
feature_groups.admissible_range: Unsigned 16-bit integer; exact observed values are not supplied.

feature_groups.name: icmp.seq_le
feature_groups.definition: ICMP sequence number represented in little-endian form.
feature_groups.admissible_range: Nonnegative integer within the ICMP sequence-number field; exact observed values are not supplied.

feature_groups.name: http.content_length
feature_groups.definition: HTTP Content-Length field describing the message-body length when present.
feature_groups.admissible_range: Nonnegative integer when present; zero may also represent an absent or empty value after dataset encoding.

feature_groups.name: http.request.method
feature_groups.definition: Categorical HTTP request method extracted from the request line.
feature_groups.admissible_range: Public HTTP method tokens represented by the fitted categorical group; private category frequencies are not supplied.

feature_groups.name: http.request.version
feature_groups.definition: Categorical HTTP protocol version extracted from the request line.
feature_groups.admissible_range: Public HTTP version tokens represented by the fitted categorical group; private category frequencies are not supplied.

feature_groups.name: http.response
feature_groups.definition: Indicator that the HTTP message is a response.
feature_groups.admissible_range: false or true before preprocessing.

feature_groups.name: http.tls_port
feature_groups.definition: Indicator that unencrypted HTTP was detected on a port ordinarily associated with encrypted HTTP traffic.
feature_groups.admissible_range: Dataset-coded indicator values; exact observed frequencies are not supplied.

feature_groups.name: tcp.ack
feature_groups.definition: TCP acknowledgment number interpreted by the packet parser.
feature_groups.admissible_range: Unsigned 32-bit TCP sequence-space value; exact observed values are not supplied.

feature_groups.name: tcp.ack_raw
feature_groups.definition: Raw TCP acknowledgment-number field.
feature_groups.admissible_range: Unsigned 32-bit TCP sequence-space value; exact observed values are not supplied.

feature_groups.name: tcp.checksum
feature_groups.definition: TCP checksum field used for segment integrity checking.
feature_groups.admissible_range: Unsigned 16-bit checksum value or its dataset-coded representation; exact observed values are not supplied.

feature_groups.name: tcp.connection.fin
feature_groups.definition: Indicator that a TCP connection-finish (FIN) condition is present.
feature_groups.admissible_range: false or true before preprocessing.

feature_groups.name: tcp.connection.rst
feature_groups.definition: Indicator that a TCP connection-reset (RST) condition is present.
feature_groups.admissible_range: false or true before preprocessing.

feature_groups.name: tcp.connection.syn
feature_groups.definition: Indicator that a TCP connection-establishment request (SYN) is present.
feature_groups.admissible_range: false or true before preprocessing.

feature_groups.name: tcp.connection.synack
feature_groups.definition: Indicator that a TCP connection-establishment acknowledgment (SYN+ACK) is present.
feature_groups.admissible_range: false or true before preprocessing.

feature_groups.name: tcp.flags
feature_groups.definition: Combined TCP control-flags field.
feature_groups.unit: flag bit mask or dataset-coded label
feature_groups.admissible_range: Values represent combinations of TCP control flags; exact observed combinations are not supplied.

feature_groups.name: tcp.flags.ack
feature_groups.definition: Indicator that the TCP ACK control flag is set.
feature_groups.admissible_range: false or true before preprocessing.

feature_groups.name: tcp.len
feature_groups.definition: Length of the TCP segment payload reported by the parser.
feature_groups.admissible_range: Nonnegative integer; exact observed values are not supplied.

feature_groups.name: tcp.seq
feature_groups.definition: TCP sequence number interpreted by the packet parser.
feature_groups.admissible_range: Unsigned 32-bit TCP sequence-space value; exact observed values are not supplied.

feature_groups.name: udp.stream
feature_groups.definition: Index identifying the UDP conversation stream assigned by the packet parser.
feature_groups.admissible_range: Nonnegative parser-assigned index; the value is an identifier rather than a physical measurement.

feature_groups.name: udp.time_delta
feature_groups.definition: Elapsed time since the previous packet in the UDP stream.
feature_groups.admissible_range: Nonnegative time offset; exact observed values are not supplied.

feature_groups.name: dns.qry.name.len
feature_groups.definition: Length of the DNS query name.
feature_groups.admissible_range: Nonnegative integer within the DNS name encoding limits; exact observed values are not supplied.

feature_groups.name: dns.qry.qu
feature_groups.definition: Indicator for a DNS QU question requesting a unicast response.
feature_groups.admissible_range: false or true before preprocessing.

feature_groups.name: dns.qry.type
feature_groups.definition: DNS resource-record query type code.
feature_groups.admissible_range: Unsigned DNS type code; exact observed values are not supplied.

feature_groups.name: dns.retransmission
feature_groups.definition: Indicator that the DNS message is a retransmission.
feature_groups.admissible_range: false or true before preprocessing.

feature_groups.name: dns.retransmit_request
feature_groups.definition: Indicator or label identifying a retransmitted DNS query.
feature_groups.admissible_range: Dataset-coded retransmission states; exact observed frequencies are not supplied.

feature_groups.name: dns.retransmit_request_in
feature_groups.definition: Frame number of the original DNS request associated with a retransmission.
feature_groups.admissible_range: Nonnegative frame index when present; zero may encode absence after dataset preprocessing.

feature_groups.name: mqtt.conack.flags
feature_groups.definition: Flags carried by an MQTT CONNACK packet.
feature_groups.admissible_range: Nonnegative integer within the MQTT CONNACK flag field; exact observed values are not supplied.

feature_groups.name: mqtt.conflag.cleansess
feature_groups.definition: MQTT CONNECT clean-session flag.
feature_groups.admissible_range: false or true before preprocessing.

feature_groups.name: mqtt.conflags
feature_groups.definition: Combined MQTT CONNECT flags field.
feature_groups.admissible_range: Nonnegative integer within the MQTT CONNECT flag field; exact observed combinations are not supplied.

feature_groups.name: mqtt.hdrflags
feature_groups.definition: MQTT fixed-header flags field.
feature_groups.admissible_range: Nonnegative integer within the MQTT fixed-header flag field; exact observed combinations are not supplied.

feature_groups.name: mqtt.len
feature_groups.definition: MQTT message length reported by the parser.
feature_groups.admissible_range: Nonnegative integer; exact observed values are not supplied.

feature_groups.name: mqtt.msg_decoded_as
feature_groups.definition: Categorical parser label describing how an MQTT message was decoded.
feature_groups.admissible_range: Parser-defined categorical values represented by the fitted group; private frequencies are not supplied.

feature_groups.name: mqtt.msgtype
feature_groups.definition: MQTT control-packet message-type code.
feature_groups.admissible_range: Integer MQTT message-type code; exact observed values are not supplied.

feature_groups.name: mqtt.proto_len
feature_groups.definition: Length of the MQTT protocol-name field.
feature_groups.admissible_range: Nonnegative integer; exact observed values are not supplied.

feature_groups.name: mqtt.protoname
feature_groups.definition: Categorical MQTT protocol-name token.
feature_groups.admissible_range: Public MQTT protocol-name tokens represented by the fitted group; private frequencies are not supplied.

feature_groups.name: mqtt.topic_len
feature_groups.definition: Length of the MQTT topic-name field.
feature_groups.admissible_range: Nonnegative integer; exact observed values are not supplied.

feature_groups.name: mqtt.ver
feature_groups.definition: MQTT protocol-version field.
feature_groups.admissible_range: Nonnegative MQTT version code; exact observed values are not supplied.

feature_groups.name: mbtcp.len
feature_groups.definition: Modbus/TCP length field in the MBAP header.
feature_groups.admissible_range: Unsigned 16-bit length value; exact observed values are not supplied.

feature_groups.name: mbtcp.trans_id
feature_groups.definition: Modbus/TCP transaction identifier in the MBAP header.
feature_groups.admissible_range: Unsigned 16-bit identifier; the value is an identifier rather than a physical measurement.

feature_groups.name: mbtcp.unit_id
feature_groups.definition: Modbus/TCP unit identifier in the MBAP header.
feature_groups.admissible_range: Unsigned 8-bit identifier; the value is an identifier rather than a physical measurement.

classes.name: benign
classes.description: Normal IoT/IIoT traffic without an attack label in the dataset's primary family system.

classes.name: dos_ddos
classes.description: Denial-of-service and distributed denial-of-service traffic, including the paper's TCP SYN, UDP, HTTP, and ICMP flood attacks.

classes.name: information_gathering
classes.description: Reconnaissance traffic used to collect target information, including port scanning, operating-system fingerprinting, and vulnerability scanning.

classes.name: injection
classes.description: Application-layer injection traffic, including cross-site scripting, SQL injection, and malicious file-upload attacks.

classes.name: malware
classes.description: Traffic associated with the paper's backdoor, password-cracking, and ransomware attack scenarios.

classes.name: man_in_the_middle
classes.description: Man-in-the-middle traffic represented by DNS-spoofing and ARP-spoofing scenarios in the paper.
